name: Evans Ambient Occlusion
aliases: Ambient Occlusion via Distance Field Sampling
definition: A method to measure the visibility of the sky from any point in the scene considered for shading, using the difference between the sampled distance along the normal and the distance field value at that sample point.
summary: Evans Ambient Occlusion approximates occlusion by sampling a global Signed Distance Field along the surface normal, distinguishing itself from other methods by relying on a distance field texture rather than local geometry.
